verdict.rationale: Notte's marketing site lists "Live View & Replays" with session playback, and the docs describe a ViewerUrl for watching sessions live and frame the platform as a place to "build, debug, and deploy" workflows. That points to video-style replay of runs, but no documentation describes how replays help debug failed agent runs. Missing for 10: per-step screenshots, a step-by-step action timeline or logs, in-depth replay docs (retention, access via API/SDK), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
